item.title: Testing Apache Superset: A Practical Journey into Enterprise Open-Source BI
item.description: Abstract When business teams ask for dashboards, developers usually face two extremes. On one side are commercial tools like Power BI and Tableau. They work well, but per-seat licenses get expensive fast when user counts grow into the hundreds. On the other side are simpler open-source tools that set up in minutes, but quickly hit walls when you need granular security, scheduled headless reports, or deep SQL exploration. In this post, we will explore Apache Superset from a developer’s perspective.
